units.source_text: 后来我知道他也是临济宗的禅家子弟时，我明白了，他的第一次解答多少表现了他这个禅僧的作态。

en.t: Later, when I learned that he too was the son of a Rinzai Zen family, I understood that his first answer had shown, to some degree, the affected manner of a Zen monk.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，也不能否定这时他给我留下了强烈的印象。

en.t: Even so, it could not be denied that at that moment he left a strong impression on me.
